summary_bullets: Reclassify persistent Step 5 starting-round misses as non-tracking stalls with diagnostics.
Add an artifact-anchored entry-time past-cap resume path for MAV loop restarts.
Cover starting-round resume, retry, anchor rejection, and high-round attack regressions in the review-and-fix shard.
commit_message:
Fix Step 5 starting-round resume handling

Reorder loop entry handling so cap-boundary MAV restarts can emit the non-stalled mav-resume-past-cap envelope when the prior round artifact exists. Add a bounded prior-artifact retry with diagnostics and preserve STALL_TRACKING=false for starting-round-invalid stalls.

Cover the retry, anchored cap resume, inflated-cap, missing-artifact, and high starting-round paths in a dedicated review-and-fix shard.
